**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement contains no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, early-termination fee, or minimum-fee-on-termination:

- **§ 11 Fees (p0084)** — Sparkling's only payment obligation is the fees in the Fee Schedule; no stipulated or accelerated amounts.
- **§ 17(b) (p0118)** — Sparkling may terminate at any time on 90 days' notice; the only consequences are ceasing use and certifying destruction/return. No termination charge and no payment of the remaining contract value.
- **§ 17(c) (p0128)** — On Garman's default the mechanics run in our favour (licence converts to perpetual, fees for unrendered services refunded).
- **§ 15 (p0105)** — Mutual limitation of liability, not a liquidated-damages formula.
- **p0090** — The single use of "penalties" sits inside Garman's IP indemnity *to* us, which is favourable and must not be flagged.

No redline proposed. One watch item noted in the rationale: Schedule "A" (Fee Schedule) is referenced but not reproduced in the reviewed text, so we should confirm it carries no stipulated early-termination or minimum-fee amount; if one appears, our fallback is to cap it at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount.
